title: Delayed confirmations
summary: Order confirmation emails arrive later and later: minutes, then the better part of an hour.
alert: [TICKETS] "I paid, but got no confirmation": 37 tickets since this morning

questions.prompt: Where are the confirmation emails waiting?

choices.label: In the order-events topic: the worker reads it more slowly than orders come in
In the API, which sends them in the background

questions.prompt: Why can't the worker keep up?

choices.label: It handles one message at a time, and each one waits ~650 ms for MailWave
MailWave rejects most emails, and they are retried

questions.prompt: Would running four worker instances fix it?

choices.label: No: the topic has a single partition, and a partition is read by one consumer of the group at a time
Yes, if they share a bigger database pool
No: a topic can only have one consumer

slos.label: Confirmation email delay (p95)
slos.query: SELECT coalesce(round(1000 * percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM coalesce(confirmation_sent_at, $end) - created_at))), 0) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= $start AND created_at < $end - interval '10 seconds'
